info.name: Sengoku Core — QA and Local
info.description: One collection, two environments. Import the QA or Local environment and keep Postman’s cookie jar enabled. Run 00 Authentication, then 10 Feed workflow for a write-enabled local E2E run, or 20 Feed inspection for QA diagnostics. HTTPS is required by the __Host- session and CSRF cookies. Protected writes fetch a fresh CSRF token; authentication uses cookies, not Basic/Bearer tokens. Secrets are never copied into collection variables. Credentials/webhook URLs should be private environment values. Enable Keep variable values and Save cookies after collection run when continuing in the desktop app. No write or notification is automatically retried. See postman/README.md for startup, flags, concurrency and endpoint corrections.

exec: function stop(message) { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error(message); }
if (!base || !/^https:\/\//i.test(base)) stop('Select the QA or Local environment with an HTTPS baseUrl.');
if (!actualUrl.startsWith(base + '/')) stop('Request origin differs from the selected environment.');
console.info('Skipped by the selected environment flags: ' + pm.info.requestName);
// The cookie jar owns session cookies; never copy them into exportable variables or Authorization.
const missing = required.filter(key => { const value = pm.variables.get(key); return value === undefined || value === null || String(value).trim() === ''; });
if (missing.length) stop('Set required environment variables: ' + [...new Set(missing)].join(', '));
// Escape string values (including passwords containing quotes) and retain numeric/array types.
catch (_) { stop('Request body variables must contain valid JSON numbers or arrays where indicated.'); }
pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error('Set your email and password as private environment values.');
if (notify && !pm.environment.get('webhookUrl')) { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error('Set a private webhookUrl before connecting or sending.'); }
try { if (!error && response.code === 200) token = response.json().requestToken; } catch (_) { }
if (!token) stop('CSRF bootstrap failed; request was not sent.');
if (pm.response.code === 401) console.warn('Session expired or absent. Run Login in this environment, then retry manually.');
if (pm.response.code === 403) console.warn('The signed-in account does not have the required role or ownership.');
if (pm.response.code === 409) console.warn('Reload the feed or subscription to refresh its version before retrying.');
// Do not automatically replay writes or external sends after an error or timeout.

item.name: 00 Authentication
item.description: Run Login once per environment. Keep the cookie jar enabled. Secure cookies require HTTPS, including localhost.

request.description: Bootstraps the antiforgery cookie. Protected writes fetch their own request token automatically; no manual copying is necessary.
Creates an eight-hour server-side session. The collection obtains an anonymous CSRF token first. Postman retains the Secure, HttpOnly session cookie automatically. Keep credentials private.
Requires the session cookie. Returns identity and the current database-backed admin role; verifies cookie persistence between requests.

item.name: 05 Health
item.description: Read-only hosting checks; no notifications are sent.

request.description: Process liveness. Does not check the database, keys or queues.
Returns 200 only when the database and Dispatcher delivery checks pass on the same source revision. Returns 503 otherwise. Available in QA after this change is deployed.

item.name: 10 Feed workflow
item.description: Run after Authentication. Local executes against captured external services. QA writes and notifications are off by default. This workflow leaves the feed/subscription available for inspection.

request.description: Authenticated catalogue of supported games, regions and schedules. Use returned IDs in gameIds.
Admin and CSRF required. Saves feedId and feedVersion. OnInsert announces each matching parent edition once.
Authenticated, CSRF-protected and idempotent for the current account/feed/provider. Saves subscriptionId and subscriptionVersion.

Requires ownership, CSRF, allowWrites and allowExternalMessages. Verifies and encrypts the URL in Dispatcher, sends an acknowledgement and enables delivery. Reconnecting can send a current digest. expectedVersion is the subscription version.

item.name: Intake event by start.gg tournament ID

request.description: Imports the parent tournament and bracket links. Locally uses the synthetic start.gg fixture. QA contacts start.gg. Database change triggers feed the delivery outbox.

Reads owner-scoped history. Polls GET only for up to 75 seconds, looking for a Sent delivery after the workflow started. Normal delivery polling is 30 seconds; an existing subscription may be in its one-hour cooldown.

exec: let found = deliveries.find(x => x.status === 'Sent' && Date.parse(x.completedAtUtc || x.completedAt) >= since);

item.name: 20 Feed inspection
item.description: Read-only diagnostics plus a non-mutating CSRF-protected preview.

request.description: Authenticated shared catalogue; admins can also see disabled definitions.
Refresh feedVersion before editing the definition.
Authenticated and CSRF-protected preview; does not create deliveries or send messages.
Returns only the signed-in account’s subscriptions.
Refresh subscriptionVersion before reconnecting. Feed and subscription versions are separate.
Latest 50 owner-scoped outcomes. Failed/SecretUnavailable means key access failed and the subscription was paused. Unknown requires checking delivery history before retrying.

request.description: Admin and CSRF required. Uses feedVersion; reload Get feed after a 409.
